records.title: Project Memory Authority, Lifecycle, and Provenance Foundation
records.question: What controlling policies, authority hierarchy, trust classes, freshness model, and provenance rules should govern Project Memory before any schema, scanner, registry, renderer, or retrieval tool exists?
records.selected_option: ACCEPTED as a parallel governance, documentation, and developer infrastructure workstream. Defined seven-tier authority hierarchy, eight trust classes, commit-bound freshness, supersession, conflicting-evidence resolution, owner-decision representation, generated-evidence requirements, memory-update approval, roadmap synchronization, stale-index behavior, tool provenance, prompt-injection boundaries, branch synchronization policy, and product boundaries.
records.rationale: Without normalized controlling policies, context tools, retrieval systems, agent prompts, and generated indexes could silently drift from the authoritative roadmap and live code.

records.title: Schema and Normalized-Registry Architecture
records.question: What exact data model, schema standard, registry decomposition, stable identifier contract, and validation architecture should Project Memory adopt?
records.selected_option: JSON as canonical tracked registry format; JSON Schema Draft 2020-12 as formal data contract; one schema bundle with typed $defs; 12 separate normalized registry files; registry manifest; dependency-free standard-library validator; tracked source versus generated snapshot separation; stable namespaced identifiers; enforced trust classes, lifecycle values, and cross-record references.
records.rationale: The architecture must support deterministic comparison between plan and implementation, allow later scanners and renderers to extend records without replacing identifiers, and enforce product safety boundaries through structural validation.

records.title: T006/T007 Owner Deferral for No Measured Capability Gap
records.question: Should T006 or T007 be activated when no benchmarkable capability gap has been measured?
records.selected_option: No. Keep T006 and T007 contingent, planned, inactive, owner-deferred, and unimplemented. T008 proceeds with deterministic Project Memory sources and ordinary read-only repository access.
records.rationale: No concrete symbol-navigation, retrieval-quality, citation, scale, latency, or maintainability gap currently justifies either pilot. T005's zero-artifact result reflects worktree topology, not a Serena or vector-retrieval deficiency.

records.title: Shared Agent Guidance and Project Memory Ask
records.question: How should Codex, OpenCode, and compatible agents ask bounded Project Memory questions without a retrieval pilot?
records.selected_option: Use a deterministic read-only Ask protocol, shared repository skill, and strictly read-only OpenCode agent over accepted repository sources, normalized navigation records, and current generated publications with explicit authority, freshness, conflict, uncertainty, and owner-decision reporting. Derive next-actionable Project Memory work from normalized task records and linked accepted owner decisions, and validate every rendered package against its selected snapshot-bound normalized state.
records.rationale: The repository already provides sufficient deterministic sources and ordinary read-only inspection for the measured need. Fail-closed guidance prevents generated evidence, model output, or agent behavior from mutating project truth. Snapshot-bound semantic validation preserves internally consistent historical publications while current publications still converge with current tracked registries; contingent owner-deferred pilots remain visible without blocking actionable successors.

records.title: Deterministic Plan Integrity Engine
records.question: What exact deterministic classifications, rule groups, evidence requirements, and readiness states govern Plan Integrity?
records.selected_option: Use matching, diverging, superseded, conflicting, and insufficient_evidence comparisons; READY, READY_WITH_ADVISORIES, and BLOCKED readiness; exact evidence and confidence bases; six bounded integrity rule groups; and generated_evidence-only atomic reports.
records.rationale: Exact rule evaluation provides reproducible plan-versus-implementation evidence without semantic guessing, confidence-as-truth, automatic resolution, or authoritative-state mutation.

records.title: Specialized Plan Integrity Reviewers
records.question: How may specialized reviewers surface bounded Plan Integrity concerns without becoming authority or changing T009 readiness?
records.selected_option: Use six strictly read-only OpenCode reviewer definitions backed by one shared protocol and skill plus deterministic guidance and supplied-finding validation; keep every reviewer output generated_evidence and T009 the sole readiness authority.
records.rationale: Bounded permissions, exact evidence binding, deterministic normalization, and explicit non-authority preserve owner control while allowing later operator-invoked domain review without automatic scheduling or semantic truth selection.

records.title: Synchronization, CI, Rebuild, and Operational Rollout
records.question: What synchronization cadence, stale-index contract, deterministic refresh, CI rebuild, and publication procedure closes Project Memory operational rollout?
records.selected_option: Use an event-driven commit-bound cadence; owner-controlled complete-commit synchronization; read-only status diagnosis; one-command clean-HEAD refresh; ephemeral exact-commit CI rebuild; deterministic inventories, checksums, bindings, semantic and authority validation, and quality packages; no cron or automatic Git/authority mutation.
records.rationale: Repository divergence rather than elapsed time determines freshness. Deterministic validation and rebuild provide reproducible evidence while preserving owner control and generated-evidence non-authority.

records.title: Whole Remaining MVP Plan Integrity Owner Acceptance
records.question: What authoritative remaining-MVP order, activation boundary, dependency graph, missing deliverables, validation reuse, and terminal gate should govern delivery after the bound council review?
records.selected_option: Accept the bounded consolidated planning changes: PHASE8-IMPL-024 order T003->T006->T007->T004->T005->T008; PHASE8-IMPL-025 activation only after full parent closeout plus FRESH refresh; shared contracts then contributor branches and joins; API/UI/compatibility/NCP obligations; provisioning in T005/T006; reusable T008 baseline and T012 deltas; terminal PHASE8-IMPL-027 owner gate.
records.rationale: The owner accepted only the bounded planning conclusions from the checksum-verified generated-evidence package. Explicit tracked authority resolves contradictory order, activation, dependency, completeness, and terminal-gate records without authorizing application implementation.
